description: React component for a progress tracking page in a gym management system. It manages exercise logs and body metrics, handling data fetching, creation, and deletion through API endpoints. The file provides a UI for members to view and update their fitness progress.

methods.name: fetchLogs
methods.description: Fetches exercise logs from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: fetchMetrics
methods.description: Fetches body metrics data from the API and updates the state.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Adds a new exercise log via API POST request.

methods.name: deleteLog
methods.description: Deletes an exercise log by ID via API DELETE request.

methods.name: addMetric
methods.description: Adds a new body metric entry via API POST request.
